Specification: This specification models a tiny symbolic state machine with a single variable, state, that starts in the string value "Init" and can transition to either "A" or "B". The action A directly sets the next-state value to "A", while B existentially quantifies over a finite set and introduces a LET-bound local value before setting the next-state value to "B", apparently to exercise slicing or symbolic-transition extraction behavior rather than to model a realistic distributed algorithm. The file defines an initialization predicate, a next-state relation as the disjunction of the two actions, and a simple invariant asserting that the current state is not equal to "B"; there are no temporal properties, fairness assumptions, faults, proofs, or PlusCal constructs.
